hilichurl.name: Hilichurl
hilichurl.description: Primitive monsters found in the wilds of Teyvat. They seem to lack intelligence and possess a simple social structure.
hilichurl.behavior: Attacks on sight with simple club swings.

hilichurl_fighter.name: Hilichurl Fighter
hilichurl_fighter.description: A Hilichurl that uses a club for offense. More aggressive than a standard Hilichurl.
hilichurl_fighter.behavior: Charges and attacks with its club, sometimes performing jumping attacks.

hilichurl_grenadier.name: Hilichurl Grenadier
hilichurl_grenadier.description: A Hilichurl that throws slimes as projectiles. Keeps its distance.
hilichurl_grenadier.behavior: Throws Pyro slimes that explode on impact.

hilichurl_berserker.name: Hilichurl Berserker
hilichurl_berserker.description: Wields two clubs and rushes into combat. Very aggressive.
hilichurl_berserker.behavior: Quickly closes the distance and unleashes a flurry of attacks with both clubs.

mitachurl_wooden_shield.name: Mitachurl with Wooden Shield
mitachurl_wooden_shield.description: A large Hilichurl protected by a large wooden shield. The shield can be burned away to make it vulnerable.
mitachurl_wooden_shield.behavior: Defends with its shield, and attacks with powerful swings and charges.

lavachurl_stonehide.name: Stonehide Lawachurl
lavachurl_stonehide.description: The king of Hilichurls, encased in tough Geo armor. Incredibly strong and resilient.
lavachurl_stonehide.behavior: Uses Geo armor which can be broken with Geo attacks or a claymore. Performs jumping attacks that create shockwaves.
